description: Searches the HYPEIBIZA catalogue for sneakers and streetwear by name, model or style code and returns up to 10 products with the lowest shop price.

query.description: A product name, model, brand or style code, for example 'jordan 1 low' or 'DD1391-100'.

size.description: Only products a shop has in stock in this size; the price is then the lowest price in that size.
